sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.role: Drive network (OSMnx), schools/community sites/libraries (shelter sites), hospitals, fire stations, bus stops, neighbourhood names
sources.limitations: Completeness varies by feature. Speeds are imputed from road class where maxspeed is missing.

sources.name: Earthquake liquefaction scenario: San Andreas (all northern segments)
sources.role: Liquefaction hazard (High/Moderate) and shaking intensity (MMI) for the scenario rupture. Fire fuel = residential street density outside parks and water (OSM)
sources.limitations: Scenario hazard map, not a prediction. Road damage and fire ignition are seeded game events.

sources.name: American Community Survey 5-year estimates (tract)
sources.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, via Esri Living Atlas 'ACS Context for Emergency Response'
sources.role: Population, age 65+, households without a vehicle, poverty, disability, limited English, no internet access
sources.limitations: Survey estimates with margins of error. Population is distributed along residential streets (dasymetric), so at-risk counts are modelled.
